audit_close_run_arguments_invalid.fix: Run `finassist audit close-run --state-dir DIR --run RUN_ID --command NAME` on its own. `--run` and `--command` are only for close-run, and `--export` can't be combined with it.
audit_close_run_arguments_invalid.summary: audit close-run needs both --run and --command and takes no --export; those two options need close-run.

audit_context_invalid.fix: This indicates a bug; open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
audit_context_invalid.summary: An audit event was written with a malformed internal run ID, so the ledger refused it.

audit_context_required.fix: This indicates a bug; open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
audit_context_required.summary: A command start, completion or failure event had no valid run context or command name, so the ledger refused it.

audit_evidence_missing.fix: Point `--state-dir` or the global `--audit-dir` at the private state directory your earlier commands used (the default is the repository's `.finassist`). Read-only queries never create a ledger.
audit_evidence_missing.summary: No audit ledger exists in the selected state directory, so a read-only history query has nothing to inspect.

audit_integrity_failed.fix: Don't edit, prune or reset the ledger, and don't retry. Keep a private copy of the state directory, check for another writer or a restored or edited file, and compare it with a known-good backup before continuing.
audit_integrity_failed.summary: The audit ledger failed verification: its hash chain, an event or the reservation balances don't match, so work stops.

audit_lifecycle_invalid.fix: If you closed this run with `audit close-run` while it was still working, its result was not recorded; check its outputs. Otherwise this indicates a bug; open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
audit_lifecycle_invalid.summary: A command lifecycle event was out of order: a second start, an unmatched completion, or a completion for a run closed with `audit close-run`.

audit_read_only.fix: This indicates a bug; open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
audit_read_only.summary: Code tried to write an event through a read-only ledger connection, which is never allowed.

audit_reserved_field.fix: This indicates a bug; open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
audit_reserved_field.summary: An audit event tried to set a field the ledger reserves for itself (run ID, timestamp or schema), so it was refused.

audit_run_command_mismatch.fix: Check the ID against `incomplete_runs` in `finassist audit`, and pass the `command` shown beside it to `--command`.
audit_run_command_mismatch.summary: The --command given to audit close-run isn't the command recorded for that run.

audit_run_not_incomplete.fix: Run `finassist audit` with the same state directory and pass a `run_id` from `incomplete_runs` to `--run`. A finished or already closed run needs nothing, and a command can't close its own run.
audit_run_not_incomplete.summary: The run given to audit close-run isn't listed as incomplete in this ledger.

audit_unavailable.fix: Check that the audit directory is on a local disk and writable, and that no other process holds the database open. Then reload the dashboard.
audit_unavailable.summary: The dashboard couldn't read or write the local audit database for this request.

configuration_changed_reload.fix: Reload the dashboard, re-enter your edits, then preview and confirm again. Avoid editing the same configuration file elsewhere while the dashboard is open.
configuration_changed_reload.summary: The configuration file changed after the dashboard loaded it or after the preview, so the preview no longer applies.

configuration_invalid.fix: Run `finassist --config finassist.json doctor` against your file to see the specific validation code, fix the file, then refresh the dashboard. The Health tab stays available meanwhile.
configuration_invalid.summary: The dashboard can't read or validate the configuration file, so settings and statistics are unavailable.

configuration_saved_audit_unknown_reload.fix: Reload the dashboard and check the configuration on disk before you change anything again. Inspect the open audit run before retrying.
configuration_saved_audit_unknown_reload.summary: The configuration may have been saved, but the save couldn't be confirmed or recorded.

daily_budget_exceeded.fix: Run `finassist audit` and settle open reservations with `finassist reconcile-budget` from verified billing, wait for the next UTC day, or raise `daily_budget_usd` in the reviewed configuration or gate policy.
daily_budget_exceeded.summary: This model call's estimated cost would push today's spend, including unresolved reservations, over the daily budget.

dashboard_assets_invalid.fix: Don't edit the packaged assets or manifest. Reinstall the package from a trusted source; in a source checkout, rebuild with `pnpm run build` in `dashboard/` and compare the result with the committed files.
dashboard_assets_invalid.summary: The packaged dashboard files don't match their integrity manifest, so the dashboard won't start.

dashboard_assets_missing.fix: Reinstall the package from a trusted source; in a source checkout, rebuild with `pnpm run build` in `dashboard/` so the manifest includes `index.html`.
dashboard_assets_missing.summary: The packaged dashboard manifest lists no index.html entry page, so the dashboard can't start.

doctor_directory_unusable.fix: Choose a private writable directory without symlinks. Check parent permissions; metadata cannot prove write access.
doctor_directory_unusable.summary: A doctor directory is not a usable writable location.

explicit_confirmation_required.fix: Select Confirm and save after reviewing the preview. API clients must send a JSON object with exactly `proposal_id` and `confirm`, with `confirm` set to true.
explicit_confirmation_required.summary: A configuration save was requested without an explicit confirmation, so nothing was saved.

init_repository_required.fix: Run init inside a Git repository, or use init --template to write the fixed layout without detection.
init_repository_required.summary: Repository detection could not find a Git repository for init.

invalid_actual_cost.fix: Pass the verified provider charge in USD to `--actual-usd` as a finite number of zero or more, for example 0.42.
invalid_actual_cost.summary: The actual cost given to reconcile-budget is negative, infinite or not a number, so the reservation stays open.

invalid_audit_page.fix: Run `finassist audit --export` with `--after` set to 0 or the last exported sequence number, and `--limit` between 1 and 10000.
invalid_audit_page.summary: The audit export page is out of range: `--after` must be zero or more and `--limit` from 1 to 10,000.

invalid_dashboard_port.fix: Pass `--port` with a value from 1 to 65535, or omit it to let the operating system choose a free port.
invalid_dashboard_port.summary: The dashboard port is outside 0 to 65535, so the server isn't started.

invalid_monthly_budget.fix: This indicates a bug, since configuration validation already requires a finite `monthly_budget_usd` of zero or more; open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
invalid_monthly_budget.summary: The monthly budget passed to spend admission is negative or not finite, so no model call is reserved.

invalid_preview.fix: Use the dashboard's Preview changes button. API clients must send a JSON object with exactly `revision`, from the current `/api/config` response, and `changes`, an object of setting names to new values.
invalid_preview.summary: A configuration preview request didn't have exactly the `revision` and `changes` fields, so nothing was previewed.

invalid_proposal.fix: Send the `proposal_id` string exactly as returned by the preview response, or use the dashboard's Confirm and save button.
invalid_proposal.summary: The confirmation's `proposal_id` isn't a string, so it can't name a preview.

invalid_request.fix: Reload the dashboard page and repeat the action. If you call the API directly, send a JSON object as the dashboard does.
invalid_request.summary: The dashboard API received a request it couldn't read.

json_required.fix: Send the request body as JSON with the header `Content-Type: application/json`.
json_required.summary: A dashboard API change request wasn't sent as JSON, so it was refused before parsing.

monthly_budget_exceeded.fix: Run `finassist audit` and settle open reservations with `finassist reconcile-budget` from verified billing, wait for the next UTC month, or raise `monthly_budget_usd` in the reviewed configuration.
monthly_budget_exceeded.summary: This model call's estimated cost would push this UTC month's spend, including unresolved reservations, over the monthly budget.

not_found.fix: Open the address the dashboard printed at startup, without a path, and navigate from there.
not_found.summary: The dashboard has no page or API route at that address.

operation_finished_audit_completion_fail.fix: Don't retry blindly. Check the command's outputs or changed files to see whether it took effect, and fix ledger access (disk space, permissions, a lock). Then run `finassist audit`; once you know what it did, close the run with `finassist audit close-run`.
operation_finished_audit_completion_fail.summary: The command may have finished, but its completion couldn't be recorded in the audit ledger, so its outcome is unknown.

origin_rejected.fix: Type the exact printed `http://127.0.0.1:PORT` address into the browser (not `localhost`, a proxy or a tunnel) and use the dashboard page itself. Requests from other sites are refused by design.
origin_rejected.summary: A dashboard request had an unexpected Host, Origin or cross-site fetch header, so it was refused to block cross-site use.

proposal_missing_or_consumed.fix: Preview the changes again and confirm the new proposal once. Previews are single-use, kept only in memory, and only the 16 most recent are retained.
proposal_missing_or_consumed.summary: The confirmed preview is unknown: it was already used, displaced by newer previews, or lost when the dashboard restarted.

reconciled_operation.fix: Nothing is blocked. Check what the closed command may have changed (`finassist audit` lists it under `reconciled_runs`), settle any open spend with `reconcile-budget`, and rerun an abandoned workflow's plan.
reconciled_operation.summary: A command run was closed with an unknown outcome, or a damaged workflow run was abandoned, within the evidence age window.

request_size_invalid.fix: Send one `Content-Length` header and a non-chunked JSON body of 1 to 65,536 bytes.
request_size_invalid.summary: A dashboard change request lacks a single valid Content-Length, uses chunked encoding, or is empty or over 65,536 bytes.

request_target_invalid.fix: Request the plain path without a `?` query or `#` fragment, such as the printed address itself.
request_target_invalid.summary: A dashboard request URL included a query string or fragment, which the dashboard never accepts.

reservation_not_open.fix: Run `finassist audit` with the same `--state-dir` or `--audit-dir` and pass an ID from its `unresolved` list to `--reservation`. A settled reservation can't be settled again.
reservation_not_open.summary: The reservation ID given to reconcile-budget isn't in this ledger or was already settled.

run_budget_exceeded.fix: Review a smaller range, lower `max_output_tokens`, or raise `max_run_usd` in the reviewed configuration or gate policy after checking the configured prices.
run_budget_exceeded.summary: This model call's estimated cost exceeds the per-call limit `max_run_usd`, so it isn't made.

session_token_required.fix: Reload the dashboard page from the printed address to get a fresh token; tokens change each time the dashboard starts. API clients must send it in the `X-Finassist-Token` header.
session_token_required.summary: A dashboard data request lacked the current session token, so it was refused.

state_location_moved.fix: Pass `--state-dir` naming the folder to keep, or move that folder to the selected location.
state_location_moved.summary: The selected state folder has no spending ledger, and the folder this command used before still does, so a new ledger was not started.

unreconciled_model_usage.fix: Verify the actual charge in provider billing, then record it with `finassist reconcile-budget --reservation ID --actual-usd AMOUNT` on the same state directory, using an ID from `finassist audit`. Never reset the ledger.
unreconciled_model_usage.summary: A model call's charge is unresolved, from an earlier open reservation or missing token usage, so the gate blocks further calls.

unsupported_setting.fix: Change only the settings shown in the dashboard form; edit other options, such as recipe definitions or network permission, directly in the JSON configuration and reload.
unsupported_setting.summary: A preview's changes weren't an object of editable settings, or named a setting the dashboard doesn't edit.
